MASTER COLLABORATION AND REVENUE PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT

THIS MASTER COLLABORATION AND REVENUE PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made and entered into as of January 15, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and among:

(1) KEMI ADEYEMI, an individual professionally known as "Kemi A." (the "Artist");

(2) DANIEL OSEI, an individual (the "Producer"); and

(3) RUTH MENSAH, an individual (the "Manager"),

(each a "Participant" and collectively the "Participants").

RECITALS

A. The Artist has written and recorded, with the assistance of the Producer, a body of recordings intended for release as an album provisionally titled "Lagoon Static" (the "Album").

B. The Manager has provided and will continue to provide management, booking and business services in connection with the Album and related live performances.

C. The Participants wish to set out the basis on which revenue arising from the Album will be shared.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the Participants agree as follows:

ARTICLE 1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:

"Gross Receipts" means all sums actually received by or credited to the Participants, or any of them, from the exploitation of the Album in any medium, including streaming, downloads, physical sales, synchronisation licences and performance income attributable to the Album.

"Net Receipts" means Gross Receipts less (i) payment processing fees and (ii) platform and distributor fees.

"Revenue Share" means, for each Participant, the percentage of Net Receipts set out opposite that Participant's name in Schedule A, as amended from time to time.

"Statement Period" means each calendar quarter during the Term.

1.2 Headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation. Words in the singular include the plural and vice versa.

ARTICLE 2. TERM

2.1 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier in accordance with Article 8, the Term ends on January 14, 2028.

2.2 Termination shall not affect any Revenue Share accrued in respect of Gross Receipts received before the date of termination.

ARTICLE 3. FEES AND DEDUCTIONS

3.1 Payment processing fees and platform and distributor fees shall be deducted from Gross Receipts before any distribution of Net Receipts under Schedule A.

3.2 No Participant shall be entitled to deduct any personal expense from Gross Receipts without the prior written approval of the other Participants.

ARTICLE 4. PRODUCTION ADVANCE

4.1 The Producer received an advance of $3,000 (the "Production Advance") towards studio and mixing costs.

4.2 The Production Advance shall be recouped from Net Receipts before any distribution under Schedule A.

4.3 For the avoidance of doubt, the Production Advance is not repayable by the Producer other than by recoupment under clause 4.2.

ARTICLE 5. REFUNDS AND CHARGEBACKS

5.1 Where any customer is refunded or a chargeback is made in respect of a sale of the Album, the amount refunded shall be charged against the Artist's Revenue Share for the Statement Period in which the refund is made.

ARTICLE 6. ACCOUNTING

6.1 Statements shall be issued within thirty (30) days after the end of each Statement Period.

6.2 Each Participant may, on reasonable notice and not more than once in any twelve (12) month period, inspect the books and records relating to the Album.

ARTICLE 7. CURRENCY

7.1 All payments under this Agreement shall be made in USD.

ARTICLE 8. TERMINATION

8.1 Any Participant may terminate this Agreement upon ninety (90) days' written notice to the other Participants if another Participant commits a material breach which remains uncured at the end of that notice period.

ARTICLE 9. MISCELLANEOUS

9.1 This Agreement, together with its Schedules and any written amendments, constitutes the entire agreement among the Participants with respect to its subject matter.

9.2 No amendment shall be effective unless made in writing and signed by all Participants.

9.3 If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force.

SCHEDULE A: REVENUE SHARES

Participant | Revenue Share
The Artist (Kemi Adeyemi) | 45%
The Producer (Daniel Osei) | 35%
The Manager (Ruth Mensah) | 20%

SCHEDULE B: NOTICES

Notices shall be sent by email to the address each Participant last gave to the others in writing.

AMENDMENT NO. 1

This Amendment No. 1 is made on June 1, 2026 between the Artist, the Producer and the Manager and amends the Agreement.

1. With effect from June 1, 2026, Schedule A is deleted and replaced with the following: the Artist receives 45% of Net Receipts, the Producer receives 30% of Net Receipts, and the Manager receives 25% of Net Receipts.

2. The reason for this change is that the Manager has taken on additional responsibility for tour booking.

3. Except as amended by this Amendment No. 1, the Agreement remains in full force and effect.

Signed by Kemi Adeyemi, Daniel Osei and Ruth Mensah.
